product.category: Codex 多 Profile 工作台
product.tagline: 把隔离的 Codex 工作环境收进一个控制台。
product.description: 统一管理本地 Profile、历史会话、登录态备份、远程渠道和模型路由。
nonGoals: 合并不同 Profile 的 CODEX_HOME、会话和登录态
保存 SSH 私钥或把认证内容写入命令参数和诊断
绕过确认直接执行认证、路由或远端破坏性写入

capabilities.title: Profile 工作区
capabilities.body: 发现、创建、复制、启动和归档相互隔离的 Codex 环境，并快速读取关键状态。

capabilities.title: 会话中心
capabilities.body: 分页搜索会话索引，只有选中记录后才读取对应 JSONL 正文。

capabilities.title: 认证库
capabilities.body: 对登录态执行备份、预检、应用和回滚，所有写入都有保护与明确确认。

capabilities.title: 远程渠道
capabilities.body: 为指定 Profile 管理微信与飞书连接，同时保持外部运行时和凭据边界清楚。

capabilities.title: 模型路由
capabilities.body: 预览、测试、应用和恢复第三方模型路由，写配置前备份且不修改 auth.json。

workflow.label: 发现
workflow.title: 汇总本地 Profile
workflow.body: 读取默认目录和 Shell 启动函数，建立统一状态视图。

workflow.label: 诊断
workflow.title: 先运行只读 Doctor
workflow.body: 检查启动、路径、进程、认证、路由、代理和渠道，并生成脱敏建议。

workflow.label: 管理
workflow.title: 进入对应管理域处理
workflow.body: 按需加载会话、认证、渠道或路由，避免首页预取敏感正文。

workflow.label: 自动化
workflow.title: 复用同一套 JSON 合同
workflow.body: 桌面端与 CLI 共享 Rust 核心，Agent 可以按能力发现和安全顺序执行。

boundary.title: 高权限动作必须保持可见、可回滚
boundary.body: 认证、配置和远端写入均有运行状态保护、备份和显式确认。应用不保存 SSH 凭据，不把密钥写入参数或诊断，也不接管来源不明的外部进程。

website.releaseSummary: 0.1.6 Public Preview 改进远程节点管理、Profile 归档与额度工作流，并增强桌面端与 Headless CLI 的一致性。

screenshots.alt: rCodexManager 认证库的备份列表与详情

screenshots.description: 认证库展示已授权 auth.json 备份的有效性、来源、账号和应用历史，写入前通过预检、运行状态保护和恢复备份降低误操作风险。

导入前只读预检外部包
应用或回滚前确认目标 Profile

product.tagline: Bring isolated Codex environments into one control surface.
product.description: Manage local profiles, session history, authentication backups, remote messaging channels, and model routing.
nonGoals: Merge CODEX_HOME, sessions, or authentication state across profiles
Store SSH private keys or expose credentials in command arguments and diagnostics
Run destructive authentication, routing, or remote writes without explicit confirmation

capabilities.title: Profile workspace
capabilities.body: Discover, create, copy, launch, stop, and archive isolated Codex environments while keeping their paths, sessions, and login state separate.

capabilities.title: Session center
capabilities.body: Search a bounded, paginated session index and load an individual JSONL transcript only after the user selects it.

capabilities.title: Authentication vault
capabilities.body: Back up, preview, apply, and roll back authorized login state with runtime protection, recovery copies, and explicit confirmation.

capabilities.title: Remote channels
capabilities.body: Manage WeChat and Feishu connections for a selected profile while keeping third-party runtimes and credentials outside the app boundary.

capabilities.title: Model routing
capabilities.body: Preview, test, apply, and restore third-party model routes with configuration backups and no writes to auth.json.

workflow.label: Discover
workflow.title: Collect local profiles
workflow.body: Read default directories and shell launch functions to establish one status view.

workflow.label: Diagnose
workflow.title: Run the read-only doctor first
workflow.body: Check launch configuration, paths, processes, authentication, routing, proxies, and channels with redacted recommendations.

workflow.label: Manage
workflow.title: Enter the relevant management domain
workflow.body: Load sessions, authentication, channels, or routing only when needed instead of prefetching sensitive content.

workflow.label: Automate
workflow.title: Reuse the same JSON contract
workflow.body: The desktop app and CLI share the Rust core so agents can discover capabilities and follow the same guarded action order.

boundary.title: Privileged actions remain visible and recoverable
boundary.body: Authentication, configuration, and remote writes use runtime guards, backups, and explicit confirmation. The app does not store SSH credentials, place secrets in arguments or diagnostics, or take over external processes whose ownership cannot be established.

website.releaseSummary: Version 0.1.6 Public Preview improves remote node management, Profile archive and quota workflows, and desktop/Headless CLI consistency.

screenshots.alt: The rCodexManager workspace populated with public mock Profile data
screenshots.title: Profile workspace: compare every Codex environment in one view
screenshots.description: The workspace brings account, authentication, model, latest session, quota, environment, and runtime state into one compact table so users can decide whether to launch, sign in, archive, or open a management center.
highlights: Filter Profiles by search, category, state, and sort order
Review authentication, quota, latest session, and runtime state
Launch, stop, archive, or open more actions from each row
screenshots.caption: Compare accounts, authentication, sessions, quota, environment, and runtime state in one compact table with frequent lifecycle actions kept close at hand.

screenshots.alt: The paginated rCodexManager session index and on-demand detail panel
screenshots.title: Session center: search the index before reading details
screenshots.description: Session Center filters history by Profile, category, query, and page size, then reads one selected JSONL detail only after the user asks for it.
highlights: Search session titles, summaries, and sources
Narrow results by Profile and category
Read summary, cwd, and source path after selection
screenshots.caption: Search the bounded index first and load one selected transcript detail instead of scanning every JSONL body when the dialog opens.

screenshots.alt: The rCodexManager authentication vault list and detail panel
screenshots.title: Authentication vault: back up, preview, apply, and roll back login state
screenshots.description: The vault shows backup validity, source, account, and application history. Preview checks, runtime guards, and recovery backups protect every write.
highlights: Inspect backup validity, source, and account
Preview imported packages before writing
Confirm target Profile before apply or rollback
screenshots.caption: Backup validity, source, and target remain visible while previews, runtime guards, and recovery copies protect every write.

screenshots.alt: rCodexManager managing WeChat and Feishu remote channels
screenshots.title: Remote channels: bind WeChat and Feishu to a selected Profile
screenshots.description: Remote Channels manages the profile-specific WeChat bridge and external Feishu runtime, keeping binding, runtime, logs, and configuration state visible without absorbing third-party secrets.
highlights: Start and stop WeChat bridge instances per Profile
Bind an external Feishu runtime and binary path
Read redacted logs and connection state
screenshots.caption: WeChat and Feishu both operate around the selected Profile; check state and redacted logs before restarting a failed channel.

screenshots.alt: The rCodexManager model routing configuration page
screenshots.title: Model routing: test and preview before writing config.toml
screenshots.description: Model Routing keeps provider templates, model names, Responses URLs, proxy state, and diagnostics together. Draft tests do not write files, and apply requires a visible preview plus a backup.
highlights: Choose provider template, model, and base URLs
Run draft tests without changing saved config
Preview writes and keep a recovery backup
screenshots.caption: Use it to connect custom Profiles to Qwen, GLM, local models, or external Responses services while leaving auth.json untouched.

cli.highRiskPolicy: 认证导入、Profile 删除或重置、模型路由写入和远端配置变更必须先检查运行状态、生成备份并要求显式敏感操作确认。

runtime.secretPolicy: 认证正文仅保存在本机受限文件中；SSH 凭据沿用系统配置，密钥和令牌不得进入参数、节点元数据、历史或诊断。
